transcript: Speaker A: नमस्कार। एक बड़ी खबर है। अब English सीखना मुश्किल नहीं रहा। एक ऐसा app आ चुका है जो आपको Hindi में ही English बोलना सिखाता है। नाम है SpeakEasy app। इसमें कोई boring classes नहीं, कोई लंबे-लंबे lectures नहीं। सिर्फ छोटे-छोटे lessons जो आप अपनी speed से सीखते हो। जब चाहो, जहां चाहो AI teacher हमेशा तैयार है। बोलो, सुनो, सीखो। गलत बोला, तुरंत सुधार मिला। 100 बार गलती करो, 100 बार सही कराया जाता है। ना कोई शर्म, ना कोई pressure। 10-15 मिनट रोज दो, English खुद ब खुद बेहतर होती जाती है। तो अगर आपको भी real English बोलनी है, आज ही शुरू करो। [Hello. There is big news. Now learning English is no longer difficult. An app has arrived that teaches you to speak English in Hindi itself. The name is SpeakEasy app. There are no boring classes, no long lectures. Just short lessons that you learn at your own speed. Whenever you want, wherever you want, the AI teacher is always ready. Speak, listen, learn. If you speak incorrectly, you get immediate correction. Make a mistake 100 times, it is corrected 100 times. No shame, no pressure. Give 10-15 minutes daily, English automatically gets better. So if you also want to speak real English, start today.] Speaker B: अभी SpeakEasy app download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: BREAKING NEWS, PRIYA SHARMA, Speakeasy AI, Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy, Install Now
summary: An AI news anchor introduces the SpeakEasy app, which teaches English through Hindi using short, self-paced lessons. The app features an AI teacher that provides instant corrections without judgment. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
